quoted_tokens.text: ";;; this is a prelude for Alt-Ergo, Dolmen frontend"
"(define-fun __cdiv ((x Int) (y Int)) Int (ite (>= x 0) (div x y) (- (div (- x) y))))"
"(define-fun __cmod ((x Int) (y Int)) Int (ite (>= x 0) (mod x y) (- (mod (- x) y))))"
"^(error \"Can't get-info :reason-unknown when the last result wasn't unknown!\")$"
"(define-fun fp.isIntegral32 ((x Float32)) Bool (or (fp.isZero x) (and (fp.isNormal x) (= x (fp.roundToIntegral RNE x)))))"
"(define-fun fp.isIntegral64 ((x Float64)) Bool (or (fp.isZero x) (and (fp.isNormal x) (= x (fp.roundToIntegral RNE x)))))"
"(define-fun fp.isIntegral80 ((x Float80)) Bool (or (fp.isZero x) (and (fp.isNormal x) (= x (fp.roundToIntegral RNE x)))))"
"(error \".*out of memory\")\\|Cannot allocate memory\\|Maximal allocation counts .* have been exceeded\\|(error \".*number of configured allocations exceeded\")"
